title: Step 58-G testing accessibility responsive and quality gates
description: Implement only the storefront quality-gate layer: static/SSR accessibility and responsive guards, real Chromium keyboard/focus/target/reflow/reduced-motion checks, automated WCAG-tagged axe audit, and minimal remediation of foundation semantics/target/focus coverage. No customer feature implementation, business logic, backend/OpenAPI/database change, Stage H closure or Step59.

dependencies.name: Stage 58-F state errors loading and offline recovery foundation

evidence.drift_reason: Protected PR #196 advanced main before Stage 58-G Human approval registration; all prior artifact-bound gates are stale.

postmerge_browser_trigger_gap.cause: The protected merge was performed by github-actions[bot] using GITHUB_TOKEN; GitHub suppresses workflow chaining from GITHUB_TOKEN-created pushes, so the push-triggered browser-quality workflow did not run on the exact merge SHA.
postmerge_browser_trigger_gap.remediation: Add workflow_dispatch to Step 58 Storefront Quality and require an explicit run on main after the remediation merge before Stage G closure.

acceptance_criteria.description: Static/source quality gate rejects positive tabindex, autofocus, non-semantic click targets, focus suppression, physical RTL layout, reflow clipping/truncation hazards and design-token drift while tracing the Step54 accessibility/responsive contract.

All 32 placeholder route examples pass deterministic SSR semantic checks for Persian RTL document, viewport, main/H1 baseline, skip-link order, unique IDs, valid aria-controls, accessible interactive names and image alt contract.

Real Chromium gate verifies keyboard skip-link/focus transfer, compact disclosure, visible focus >=3px, 44x44 visible interactive targets, RTL runtime and no horizontal overflow across 320/360/600/840/1200/1440 widths.
Browser gate verifies prescribed text-spacing/long-Persian stress, reduced-motion runtime and 320 CSS-pixel reflow proxy for 1280px at 400 percent without claiming full product WCAG conformance.

Pinned free/open-source Playwright and axe-core audit representative compact/expanded routes and report zero WCAG-tagged axe violations; workflow has contents-read permissions and no paid/external provider.

Minimal remediation makes quick access a named nav landmark, broadens visible focus coverage to standard controls/programmatic targets, and guarantees Breadcrumb/Footer interactive targets use the 44px token.
No feature UI/business state/backend/OpenAPI/database/visual redesign/StageH/Step59 work enters Stage G.

HIGH-risk closure requires exact-artifact REVIEW, SECURITY, HUMAN and LOCK evidence; canonical verify/phase-a/merge-policy; browser-quality PASS on exact PR head; protected merge; exact-SHA postmerge verify/Phase-A; and an explicit workflow_dispatch Browser Quality PASS on the final merged main SHA.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage G is HIGH risk because it introduces CI quality enforcement. Stage H and Step59 remain forbidden until canonical postmerge verification and explicit browser-quality workflow_dispatch on final main both pass.
